prompt:
## Melted Sugar

Melted salt lit the bulb, because melting set its ions free. Now try sugar. Heat it in a pan, as when you make caramel, and near 186 °C it melts into a thick liquid and starts to turn brown.

**Predict:** Will melted sugar light the bulb?

options.text: Yes, because melting sets ions free, as it did in salt.
No, because sugar has no ions for melting to set free.
Yes, but only faintly, because any liquid conducts a little.
